title: Grouped-query: two heads per key
notes: The same sentence with grouped-query attention: heads 1 and 2 share one key and value head, heads 3 and 4 another, each the average of the two it replaces. K and V are half as wide, so the KV cache holds 4 numbers per word instead of 8. The patterns blur: sat still finds cat (0.89), but mat no longer finds sat.
ops: the cat sat on the mat
